title: design-lock.json — frozen single source of truth for one design-system skill
description: One-way derived from the design-system source (Figma MCP capture or reference images). NEVER hand-edited downstream: to change a token, screen, or threshold, edit the lock and re-derive tokens.css / tailwind fragment / renders. Scripts read this file; the model reads this file; nothing else is authoritative.

figmaProject.description: Figma project URL (informational — not consumable by MCP tools)

chromiumBuild.description: Pinned Playwright Chromium build id used for ALL renders and any self-rendered references, e.g. 'chromium-1228'. A build change invalidates the noise-floor calibration.

noiseFloorPct.description: Measured irreducible diff (identical-content control render). Thresholds must sit above this. Set by scripts/verify.mjs --calibrate.

provenance.description: Derivation receipt written by scripts/capture-figma.mjs after emitting the derived token artifacts (CONTRACT.md §Provenance). When present, adherence-lint re-derives every hash offline: a mismatch means a derived artifact was hand-edited or the lock's tokens drifted after derivation. Optional — a lock without it predates the chain (single WARN, never a hard failure).

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the derive run.

lockTokensHash.description: sha256 of the canonically serialized tokens section at derive time.

artifacts.description: lock-relative artifact path → sha256 of its bytes at derive time.

tokens.description: The token layer, derived from Figma get_variable_defs (or reference tear-down). Emitted one-way into assets/tokens.css and assets/tailwind.tokens.cjs by the capture flow — hand-editing those outputs is banned.

spacing.description: The complete allowed spacing scale in px. Any spacing value not in this list is drift.

typography.description: role (display|heading|subheading|body|body-sm|caption|label) → spec. Roles are the 7-name scale; never invent alternates.

elevation.description: level → exact box-shadow string. Pick ONE strategy; never mix.

componentMap.description: figmaNodeId → verified library component (self-bootstrapped Phase A, or Code Connect). Presence here routes a node to Mode A.

variantProps.description: Variant prop name -> allowed values (array of strings) OR the single pinned/verified value (string or boolean, matching Figma variant/boolean props).

sourceSha.description: Git SHA (or content hash) of the component source at verification time. Drift vs current → staleness warning; Mode A must re-confirm against a fresh reference.

verifiedDiffPct.description: globalPct achieved when this component last passed its pixel gate; explicit null = not yet verified.

componentKey.description: Figma library componentKey captured at verification time (library-lineage scoped — re-resolve live per target file before any push).

verifiedAt.description: Date of the last passed component pixel gate.

fixtureScreen.description: Verification fixture screen id, or an object describing the fixture binding.

verifiedWorstTile.description: Worst tile fraction at the last passed gate.

diagnosis.description: Honest note on residual diff sources when not fully converged.

verifiedAgainstNode.description: Figma nodeId the verification reference came from.

lastNumbers.description: Last gate numbers {globalPct, worstTile, rounds}; explicit null = not yet verified.

notConverged.description: True when the component ships below its cap with a diagnosis — reported honestly, never silently.

files.description: Paths to bundled woff2 files, relative to the lock

fontChecks.description: document.fonts.check() strings render.mjs must assert before shooting, e.g. '700 48px "Brand Sans"'

mode.description: A = composed from verified componentMap; B1 = generated from tokens with Figma geometry ground truth; B2 = generated from tokens with image-only reference (no geometry gate; mandatory human worst-region review)

referenceImage.description: Path to the reference PNG. Provenance rule: must come from Figma's renderer (get_screenshot at original_* dims) or a real branded capture — NEVER from our own Chromium render of generated output (both-fell-back hole), except for the calibration control screen.

url.description: URL (or file:// path) render.mjs loads. Page must set [data-render-ready] when settled.

maskedRegions.description: Dynamic-content rects zeroed in BOTH buffers before diffing. reason is required; total masked area is budget-capped by the lint (≤15% of frame).

domId.description: DOM id carrying data-fig-id; explicit null on component-fixture screens (the fixture IS the component — no sub-region).

rect.description: Ground-truth CSS-px rect from Figma get_metadata (modes A/B1)

passThreshold.description: Max globalPct (0–1). Hard-capped by caps.maxPassThreshold per mode — the lint refuses a looser value.

tileCeiling.description: Max per-64px-tile diff density (0–1). Catches concentrated failures a global average hides.

geometryTolerancePx.description: Max |Δ| per box edge for geometry.mjs (modes A/B1)

stateContract.description: Which state/variant this frame represents (empty vs populated, logged-in vs out). Prevents state-mismatch false diffs.

locales.description: Locales this screen must render without overflow; verify runs the LONGEST one. Default from content.locales.

lockedStrings.description: Content lock (CONTRACT.md §Content lock): strings that must each appear VERBATIM in this screen's visible source text, in this relative order. The content gate for referenceless/net-new screens — pixel gates only protect screens WITH a reference. Enforced by adherence-lint (section 'content-lock'): absent → no finding; present and violated → ERROR.

netNew.description: True marks a net-new screen: designed in-system with NO external reference (CONTRACT.md §Content lock). Drops the referenceImage/passThreshold/tileCeiling requirements. Such screens participate in adherence-lint (content-lock, disclosures, source adherence) and render, but the pixel/geometry gates and verify.mjs are not defined for them — gates 1–2 plus visual review carry them, reported plainly.

notConverged.description: Screen ships not-converged (CONTRACT loop discipline): report the residual plainly, never loosen the cap.

lastResult.description: Last verify numbers {globalPct, worstTile, maskedPct, rounds, verifiedAt}.

diagnosis.description: Residual-diff diagnosis for a not-converged screen.

note.description: Free working note on the screen.

content.description: Microcopy layer (plan Part 5). Banking overlay values are DRAFTS pending Legal/Compliance — anything in disclosureInventory ships flagged, never silently.

locales.description: e.g. ['ro', 'en'] — first entry is the native/primary copy language

bannedJargon.description: locale → [{term, replacement}]. Literal blocklist greps for adherence-lint; a hit blocks with the suggested replacement.

mustContain.description: Substrings/patterns whose ABSENCE blocks the content gate (fees, DAE/APR, retention, consent). ⚠ Legal: drafts, never machine-paraphrased.

diacritics.description: false = the target backend REJECTS locale special characters (e.g. Romanian comma-below): generated copy must be plain-ASCII and the ro-diacritics lint check inverts to ERROR on any special character. Absent/true = full diacritics expected.

items.description: Optional `when`: a precondition regex — the grep is only enforced in screen-source files matching it (e.g. 'data-chart' scopes chart rules to screens containing charts). Absent = unconditional.

rule.description: A non-optional signature treatment — break it and the output stops reading as this system

grep.description: Optional literal/regex check adherence-lint can run mechanically

when.description: Precondition regex scoping the grep to matching screen-source files; no matching files = signature out of scope, not violated

forbidden.description: Values that must NEVER appear in generated source — plausible substitutes from adjacent brands (a lookalike font family, a near-miss hex). The tokens section says what to use; this says what a convincing-but-wrong output would use. Enforced by adherence-lint (section 'forbidden-substitutes'); absent → silent.

fontFamilies.description: Font family names banned from generated source.

hexColors.description: Hex color strings banned from generated source.

decisions.description: Durable ledger of user mandates and interpretations (CONTRACT.md §Decisions ledger). Every ruling that shapes generation is recorded as a DEC-* entry, never only as prose. Superseded entries are marked deprecated, never deleted.

scope.description: What the ruling governs — a screen id, token group, component, or 'global'.

decision.description: The ruling itself, stated as an enforceable sentence.

rationale.description: Why the ruling was made — optional but recommended.

status.description: Deprecate superseded rulings and record the replacement; never delete history.

caps.description: HARD ceilings the lint enforces on the lock itself — a screen cannot be forced to pass by loosening its thresholds past these.

imagery.description: Imagery policy layer: tiered sourcing rules (captured assets first, derived compositions PoC-only, abstract motifs on secondary surfaces only), size classes, provenance and audit notes. Consumed by the imagery-provenance lint check and the per-system SKILL.md; shape is skill-owned working doctrine.

semanticColors.description: Semantic slots only — components never consume primitives directly. Values are exact hex/oklch strings from the source.
